channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Indonesian Passenger Ship Capsizes, Search Underway for About 130 Missing
item.description: Indonesian rescuers reported that roughly 130 passengers and crew are missing after a ferry carrying over 240 people sank in bad weather in the Java Sea.

item.title: Celine Dion Returns to Stage After Rare Illness
item.description: The Canadian singer began her 16-show residency at the Plenitude Arena in Paris. The entire series is sold out.

item.title: Young woman recounts life as ISIS bride and later informant
item.description: A young Canadian mother recalls her time as an ISIS bride and her escape from the extremist group.

item.title: Automattic confirms Mullenweg remains CEO after board ouster attempt
item.description: Automattic states Mullenweg continues as chairman and CEO with full board support.
